kind: real pinned CLI metadata connection (scripts/probe-metadata-concurrency.ts); no model request, no thread started

native.note: Before CORE.2a the reads queued behind the listing (CORE.1 run 3: connection check waited 11.2 s).

new: a slow read does not hold up other reads on the same connection
leases beyond the concurrency limit wait in order
concurrent first reads share one start and its failure
a remote error in one lease keeps the connection for the others
an aborted lease is rejected at once and leaves the shared connection serving others (rewritten)
the first thread page is cached, shared and refreshed in the background
native pagination cursors ... refresh invalidates old handles (rewritten for the cache)
